deadlines.label: Seat acceptance
deadlines.text: within 5 days of the merit list

steps.title: Check your eligibility
steps.description: Make sure you meet the basic conditions before spending time on the form.
steps.why_it_matters: Applying without meeting eligibility wastes the fee and effort.
steps.what_to_do: Compare your Class 12 subjects and aggregate marks with the eligibility section.
steps.source_quote: Candidates must have passed Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics or Biology.

steps.title: Gather your documents
steps.description: Collect the mandatory documents, plus any conditional ones that apply to you.
steps.why_it_matters: Missing documents can stop your application later.
steps.what_to_do: Use the document checklist and mark each document as prepared.

steps.title: Register on the portal
steps.description: Create your account on the admissions portal.
steps.why_it_matters: Registration is what lets you open the application form.
steps.what_to_do: Register with an email address and mobile number.
steps.source_quote: Register on the Demo Admissions Portal using an email address and mobile number between 1 February 2027 and 28 February 2027 (fictional dates).

steps.title: Fill and submit the application form
steps.description: Enter academic details, upload documents, pay the fee and submit.
steps.why_it_matters: Only submitted forms are considered for the merit list.
steps.what_to_do: Fill in academic details, upload the required documents, pay the application fee and submit.
steps.source_quote: fill in academic details, upload the required documents, pay the application fee and submit the form by 15 March 2027 (fictional date).

steps.title: Check the merit list
steps.description: See whether your name appears when the merit list is published.
steps.why_it_matters: The result decides which steps come next.
steps.what_to_do: Open the merit list, then record your result in LIFEPATH.
steps.source_quote: The merit list will be published on 1 April 2027 (fictional date).

steps.title: Accept your seat
steps.description: Confirm that you want the seat you were offered.
steps.why_it_matters: An unaccepted seat may be lost.
steps.what_to_do: Accept the seat within 5 days of the merit list.
steps.deadline_text: within 5 days of the merit list (fictional)
steps.source_quote: Selected candidates must accept the seat within 5 days, pay the admission fee and bring original documents for verification.

steps.title: Pay the admission fee
steps.why_it_matters: The notice lists the fee as part of accepting the seat.
steps.what_to_do: Pay the admission fee as instructed on the portal.
steps.deadline_text: within 5 days of the merit list (fictional)
steps.source_quote: Selected candidates must accept the seat within 5 days, pay the admission fee and bring original documents for verification.

steps.title: Bring originals for verification
steps.description: Take your original documents for verification.
steps.why_it_matters: The notice requires originals to be verified.
steps.what_to_do: Carry the originals of the documents you uploaded.
steps.source_quote: Selected candidates must accept the seat within 5 days, pay the admission fee and bring original documents for verification.

steps.title: Check the waitlist notice
steps.description: See whether you appear on the waitlist notice.
steps.why_it_matters: It is the only option this notice mentions if you are not selected.
steps.what_to_do: Look for the waitlist notice. This notice lists no other steps.
steps.source_quote: Candidates who are not selected may check the waitlist notice.
